name: AraVISTA-Bench v1.1
description: AraVISTA-Bench v1.1 is a controlled Arabic benchmark developed for evaluating temporal evidence validity, pairwise evidence relations, query-conditioned evidence states, state-aware reranking, and selective actions in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The release contains 240 Arabic queries, 592 evidence passages, 960 construction-derived query-conditioned evidence-state (QCES) labels, and 592 construction-derived directed pairwise relation labels. It also includes the frozen BM25 and Dense-E5 predictions, evaluation split definitions, aggregate results, bootstrap confidence intervals, source provenance metadata, and the implementation-aligned frozen evaluation notebook. The benchmark covers temporal counterfactuals, Gregorian–Hijri calendar equivalence, controlled dialectal temporal variants, stale-evidence traps, co-temporal conflicts, and clarification/insufficient-evidence cases. The primary HELDOUT_NEW_CHAIN split contains 200 queries, and the separate CALENDAR_CHALLENGE split contains 40 queries. Benchmark instances were constructed from temporally ordered source chains grounded in publicly accessible official institutional webpages and dated official records. The released benchmark text consists of source-grounded paraphrases and controlled benchmark constructions; the linked original webpages remain third-party materials and are not relicensed by this dataset.
